features.name: Absorb Spellfire
features.desc: As a Reaction, when you are targeted by a spell, you absorb it: you gain Spellfire charges equal to the spell's level (the pool increases with level).

features.name: Spellfire Burst
features.desc: As a Bonus Action, you expend charges to unleash a beam of Radiant or Fire flame at a target within 60 feet (damage increases with charges).

features.name: Spellfire Healing
features.desc: As an action, you expend charges to heal a creature within 60 feet or end a condition on it.

features.name: Spellfire Source
features.desc: Your maximum charges increase; you gain Resistance to Fire and Radiant damage, and when your charges overflow, you release a burst against enemies around you.
